checks.label: OTF/TTF Font
checks.message: Only OTF or TTF fonts are supported.

checks.label: Page Item Transformation
checks.message: Page item transformations (flip/skew) are not supported.

checks.label: Auto Sizing Text Box
checks.message: Auto-size text boxes were not set up properly

checks.label: Linked Text Frame
checks.message: Linked (threaded) text frames are not supported.

checks.label: Color Fill Tint (Beta)
checks.message: Fill Tint must be 100. (This may be inaccurate, testing currently)

checks.label: Color Fill Tint
checks.message: Fill Tint must be 100. Frontify shows text colours without their tint.

checks.label: Superscript/Subscript
checks.message: Superscript and subscript are not supported.

checks.label: Adobe Font
checks.message: Adobe Fonts are not supported. Use a desktop version of the font (OTF or TTF) instead.

checks.label: Unused Image
checks.message: Image(s) in package are unused making the package larger in size.

checks.label: Composer
checks.message: We recommend defining paragraph style composers as 'Adobe Single-line Composer', as browsers can render this composer. Otherwise, discrepencies between export and editing may occur.

checks.label: Baseline Shift
checks.message: Baseline shift is not supported. Shifted text sits on the baseline in Frontify.

checks.label: Large Image
checks.message: Image is large. Verify that this large of an image is needed.
